fileMover.detailRename: Your files will be automatically renamed, organized, and can be moved between libraries based on your preferences. Check the preview below to see how your files will look.

fileMover.detailWarning: This will actually move and rename files on your computer across different library folders. Make sure you're happy with the preview first!
fileMover.detailMetadata: This feature relies entirely on your books' metadata. If your metadata is missing or inconsistent, the resulting file names will be incorrect. Only recommended for well-curated libraries.
